approvals.title: Android release signing review
approvals.notes: Owner reconfirmed full release execution and approval on 2026-08-08 for 1.2.2+12 after the Play Console showed the older version 10 bundle lacked RECEIVE_SMS and the version 11 device-catalog check exposed an implicit telephony filter. The current review requires fresh APK/AAB hashes, upload-certificate preflight, APK signature verification, AAB verification, and no exposed signing material.

approvals.title: iOS release scope decision
approvals.notes: Owner expanded the current release authority to include iOS execution, distribution preparation, store inspection, upload, and submission for the complete app scope.

approvals.title: Release-owner go/no-go approval
approvals.notes: Owner explicitly reconfirmed full execution and approval of every app task for current version 1.2.2+12, including use of authenticated computer and Play Console capabilities, while requiring all available device, provider, and store actions to be attempted.

secret_handling: Approval evidence metadata only. Do not add secrets, signing keys, raw SMS bodies, phone/MoMo numbers, service keys, provider tokens, or production customer data.
